summary: Cellectis S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, announcing its Annual Shareholders General Meeting scheduled for June 25, 2026. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, provides the meeting date, time, and location and indicates that the notice of meeting is available on the company's website. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no special-situation terms, such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The filing simply fulfills the foreign private issuer's reporting obligations under the 1934 Act and does not constitute a material event beyond scheduling the general meeting. No special-situation classification applies.
